description:
Create a fully configured, timed post-conference evaluation survey for the '2024 International Data Science Summit'. Login to LimeSurvey (admin/Admin123!) and create a new survey with the title '2024 International Data Science Summit - Post-Event Evaluation'. Configure the following critical settings: 
1. Schedule: Set the Start Date to March 15, 2025 and Expiry Date to March 29, 2025.
2. Presentation: Enable the progress bar and disable backward navigation (users cannot change previous answers).
3. Text Elements: Write a welcome message that mentions the conference name, a thank you message, and set the End URL to 'https://www.datasciencesummit2024.org/thank-you'.
4. Content: Create a question group named 'Conference Track Preferences'. Inside it, add a Ranking question titled 'Please rank the following conference tracks from most to least valuable to you' with these 5 answer options: 'Machine Learning & Deep Learning', 'Natural Language Processing', 'Computer Vision & Image Analysis', 'Data Engineering & MLOps', 'Responsible AI & Ethics'.
